# API Contract Quality Checklist: User Authentication & Profile

**Purpose**: Validate that the endpoint requirements and contract are complete, consistent and unambiguous for the frontend consumer and for test authoring
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/user-auth.openapi.yaml](../contracts/user-auth.openapi.yaml) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does every endpoint in the spec have a request schema, a success response schema and every failure status it can produce listed in the contract? [Completeness, contracts]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the default values for new accounts (budget limit, start day) specified in both the requirements and the response schema examples? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK003 Are trimming and case-normalisation rules stated for every free-text field, not only email and name? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the success status of each mutating endpoint (201 register, 200 login/patch, 204 delete) stated in the requirements and not only in the contract? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions, plan.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "partial update" defined so that a field explicitly sent as null is distinguishable from an omitted field, for nullable fields such as telegram_chat_id? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the precision and rounding rule for monthly_budget_limit (2 decimals) stated in the requirements, not only in the data model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the 1-28 range for budget_start_day justified in the spec so a reviewer does not reopen the 29-31 question? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the exact error message strings for conflict and invalid-credentials responses fixed, so the frontend can rely on them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do the field names in the spec, the data model, the contract and the frontend planning document agree (monthly_budget_limit vs daily_budget_limit)? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the login request format (JSON body) consistent between the clarification record, FR-005 and the contract, with no leftover form-based wording? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK011 Are unauthenticated responses described with the same status, header and body across all protected endpoints? [Consistency, contracts §Unauthenticated]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the profile shape returned by register match the shape returned by GET and PATCH, field for field? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can every acceptance scenario be mapped to at least one row of the test matrix in quickstart.md, and does every FR appear in that matrix? [Traceability, quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the latency requirement stated with a percentile, a threshold, a concurrency level and the endpoints it applies to? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "register and log in in under 1 minute end to end" measurable from the API alone, or does it depend on the frontend? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for a request body with the correct fields but wrong JSON types (string for budget limit, number for name)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for an empty PATCH body (no fields at all)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the behaviour for a telegram_chat_id sent as an empty string versus null specified? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are unsupported methods and trailing-slash variants of the endpoint paths addressed, given the frontend document lists both `user/` and `transactions`? [Consistency, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Is the decision that this feature does not seed categories recorded where the categories feature will find it? [Dependency, Spec §Clarifications Q4]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the one-time local database reset required by the schema change documented for every developer, not only in quickstart.md? [Assumption, plan.md R6]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the CORS origin requirement acknowledged as API-wide plumbing owned by this feature, so later features do not redefine it? [Dependency, plan.md R8]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
